comparedReference.note: OAuth xAI video goes to the cli-chat-proxy base with /videos/generations, /videos/edits, /videos/extensions and GET /videos/{request_id}; it applies the generic xAI headers (no x-xai-token-auth), not the CLI chat identity. Only the OmniRoute generations + poll contract is ported here.

localEquivalentBeforeStaging.providerRegistry: open-sse/providers/registry/grok-cli.js: OAuth device code only (authModes [oauth]), alias gb, aliases gcli and grok-build, Responses transport https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/responses, no serviceKinds (defaults to [llm]), no videoConfig, no video models
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.asyncVideoProxy: open-sse/handlers/videoCore.js serves only providers with a registry videoConfig; grok-cli has none, so /v1/videos refuses it. Its buildHeaders sends Authorization/Content-Type/Idempotency-Key only, so adding a bare videoConfig would omit the source X-XAI-Token-Auth and x-grok-client-* headers and is not an equivalent
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.apiKeyEquivalent: open-sse/providers/registry/xai.js videoConfig https://api.x.ai/v1/videos through videoCore.js (API key, raw byte passthrough of generations/edits/extensions and GET /videos/{id}). That is the source `xai` entry, a different origin and credential; it is not changed here
localEquivalentBeforeStaging.aliasConflict: the source alias gc is the local Gemini CLI alias; it is not adopted

exports.createGrokCliVideoAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, maxPolls, submitTimeoutMs, requestTimeoutMs, wait, now } for tests
exports.buildGrokCliVideoRequest: (model, body) -> { model, prompt, image?, reference_images?, duration?, aspect_ratio?, resolution? }; throws status 400
exports.resolveGrokCliTiming: (body) -> { timeoutMs, pollIntervalMs, maxPolls } from timeout_ms / poll_interval_ms / max_polls with source ranges; throws status 400
exports.runGrokCliVideoJob: create + bounded poll; { success, url, requestId, accounting } or error result with acceptedJob
exports.grokCliToken: (credentials, now) -> { token } | { error }; OAuth accessToken only, expired token refused
exports.grokCliPublicUrl: public https URL check used for results

provider.serviceKindsNote: the entry declares no serviceKinds today, which src/shared/constants/providers.js defaults to ["llm"]; registration sets ["llm", "video"] so chat stays listed

auth.refresh: not performed by the adapter; the route refreshes the selected connection before dispatch (see integrationPoints)

models.dynamicDiscovery: none in the source for video; static list only. The provider's existing /v1/models discovery lists chat models and must not feed video

notPorted.edits: POST /videos/edits is not in the OmniRoute grok-cli contract
notPorted.extensions: POST /videos/extensions is not in the OmniRoute grok-cli contract
notPorted.asyncProxy: /v1/videos (videoCore.js) for grok-cli would need Grok media headers in videoCore buildHeaders; not part of this staging
notPorted.content: no content download; the result URL is returned, never fetched
